The evidence-member vocabulary 'download/install/start/RSS delta' is the live register cell's own wording, which an occupancy remasurement is obliged to quote byte-exactly and which likewise carries no 'peak'. Operand precision matters at fixture-authoring time, and authoring is explicitly deferred: status is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds is NOTHING, and fixtures are declared unauthored.
